ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The finite B07 ice-edge contained-receiver scope is delegated to the implementation team; the scoped hard-safety kernel remains mandatory.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact enclosed B07 south-door inspection receiver, its ice-edge deck/roof, and the exterior water-facing bulkhead.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No public opening, emergency egress, terrain discharge, liquid mutation, transport, power, signal, or B08/B09 connection is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact source/target/inverse and bulkhead-first sequencing are mandatory.
A fresh immutable source must reproach the four retained water contacts, ice targets, controlled-door handoff, and all target states immediately before mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled; failure invokes the exact reverse rollback order.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, retained-water proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact B07 ice-edge contained receiver.
